Gauhar (also Gohar) is the Persian word گوهر (gawhar) 'jewel, gem, pearl', and by extension 'essence, substance, intrinsic worth' (Middle Persian gōhr). It is used across Persian, Urdu and Pashto naming. The source gave a Devanagari character (ह) inside the 'Arabic form' (غوهر) — a script-mixing defect — and glossed it 'precious gem', which is correct.
